edges.reason: numCheeks controls the mint loop bound and payment amount inside mintCheeks.
msg.sender is the recipient of every minted token and the payer of msg.value.
msg.sender determines the withdrawal recipient and is validated against owner().
withdrawAll executes the external send of the contract balance.
The full contract balance is sent to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
withdrawAll is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner calls owner() to compare against the caller.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender() (msg.sender).
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
_msgSender returns msg.sender for access control checks.
mintCheeks calls _safeMint inside a loop, triggering recipient callbacks before the loop finishes.
mintCheeks calls random() repeatedly to select trait indices.
_safeMint performs the actual _mint of the token.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received, transferring control to the recipient.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received callback to the recipient contract.
The minted token is assigned to msg.sender, which may be an attacker-controlled contract.
block.timestamp is consumed as randomness input, making the result miner-influenced.
random() produces predictable pseudo-randomness from timestamp and difficulty.
mintCheeks computes calculatePrice() * numCheeks for the payment requirement.
numCheeks is a multiplier operand in the price multiplication.
price is an operand in the multiplication checked against msg.value.
mintCheeks calls calculatePrice() to determine the required payment.
calculatePrice returns the price state variable.
baseURI parameter is written into the _baseTokenURI state variable.
setBaseURI writes _baseTokenURI.
setBaseURI reads isBaseURIFrozen to block changes after freezing.
setBaseURI is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
_baseURI returns the _baseTokenURI state variable.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to fetch the base path.
_tokenId parameter is concatenated into the returned URI.
getTokenURI delegates to tokenURI.
tokenId parameter is forwarded from getTokenURI to tokenURI.
compareStrings hashes parameter a for comparison.
compareStrings hashes parameter b for comparison.
mintCheeks calls compareStrings to branch on tattoo trait names.
startMint sets hasMintStarted to true.
pauseMint sets hasMintStarted to false.
startMint is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
pauseMint is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
freezeBaseURI writes isBaseURIFrozen to true.
freezeBaseURI is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
newOwner parameter is passed to _setOwner.
transferOwnership calls _setOwner with the new address.
transferOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0)).
renounceOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
The constructor calls setBaseURI to initialise the token URI.
The constructor calls the ERC721 constructor with name and symbol.
_mint increments the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint writes the new owner into _owners.
_transfer updates sender and recipient balances.
_transfer writes the new owner into _owners.
from parameter is validated and debited in _transfer.
to parameter is validated and credited in _transfer.
tokenId parameter is used to look up and reassign ownership in _transfer.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
ownerOf reads the _owners mapping.
Address.sendValue executes a low-level call{value} forwarding all gas to the recipient.
Address.functionCallWithValue executes a low-level call{value} with arbitrary calldata.
mintIndex is computed from totalSupply() during the mint loop.
mintIndex is the token id supplied to _safeMint.
The local tattoo selection flows into the Cheek struct pushed by mintCheeks.
The derived tattooColor flows into the Cheek struct pushed by mintCheeks.
The derived tattooCheek flows into the Cheek struct pushed by mintCheeks.
The loop counter i bounds the mintCheeks iteration.
mintCheeks pushes a new Cheek struct into the cheeks array.
cheeks.length is mixed into the random() seed computation.
random() writes the newly computed value into seed.
random() reads the previous seed value to derive the next one.
mintCheeks requires hasMintStarted to be true, gating public minting.
mintCheeks validates totalSupply() + numCheeks against MAX_CHEEKS.
